question: m02
q: What's the real cash rate - the cash rate minus trimmed mean inflation?

transcript.answer:
The real cash rate is about **0.8%** (0.76% unrounded).

- **Cash rate:** 4.36% (monthly average, September 2026)
- **Trimmed mean inflation:** 3.6% year-on-year (August 2026)

The two series end in different months because the trimmed mean for September hasn't been published yet. Using the same measure, the real cash rate has been rising: it was about 0.75 percentage points in August 2026 and only 0.1 points in June 2026 (4.35% vs 3.6%)... no, let me correct that: in June 2026 the cash rate was 4.35% and trimmed mean was 3.6%, so the real rate was also about 0.75%. The real rate has narrowed since January 2026, when the cash rate was 3.6% and trimmed mean was 3.3%, a real rate of about 0.3%.
